name: dspic33ep512gp806
description: Microchip dsPIC33EP512GP806 (16-bit DSC, 64-pin, 70 MIPS, 512 KB flash, 52 KB RAM): XC16 toolchain, Renode CPU.dsPIC33 core (dsPIC33E model)

image.notes: program word at ISA address a sits at 0x01000000 + 2a, 4 bytes (24-bit instruction + phantom byte), the byte layout of XC16 HEX files

renode.notes: dsPIC33E: SFRs to 0x0FFF, RAM and stack from 0x1000, interrupt controller at 0x0800 (INT0-INT4 pin inputs 256..), DSRPAG/DSWPAG paging, 15-channel DMA at 0x0B00, ports B-G at 0x0E10 ('portd OnGPIO 4 true'), pin select RP/RPI n = 16 x port + pin. ADC1 inputs 'adc1 SetVoltage <uV> <AN>' (spare channels 16-23 are the comparator pins without ANx). Set FPWRT in the fuses (the erased FPOR gives a 128 ms power-up delay). Generated by tools/dspic30/gen_platform33e.py; docs: tools/dspic30/PERIPHERALS_33E.md.

reference.simulator: sim30 device dspic33epsuper (tools/dspic30/difftest.py --family 33e); sim30 is wrong for nested DO, CPBxx targets, CP #lit8 flags, MUL to an accumulator and page-register reads, which tests/dspic33e/cpu33e.c checks against DS70157
